first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields can improve time-to-value and durable SMB activation. I would verify those records before testing a focused simplification. Use a small guarded test with stop conditions on qualified activation, retention, and pipeline quality so a completion lift does not mask lower-value or poorly qualified accounts. Pricing pressure is real, but promotional pricing has greater margin and revenue-quality risk for the primary long-term objective.

final.rationale: Run a focused onboarding simplification experiment to address the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, making it the strongest fit for sustainable qualified revenue. Use SMB signup simplification only where relevant, while monitoring qualified revenue because its prior retention result was slightly negative. Stop or roll back if qualified activation, 30-day retention, or qualified revenue declines despite higher completion.
